name: eugene-erg/open-api
description: Object-oriented builder and reader for OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 specifications, with automatic $ref deduplication.

scripts-descriptions.stan: Run PHPStan static analysis at max level.
scripts-descriptions.cs: Report coding standard violations without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.check: Run coding standards, static analysis and tests.
scripts-descriptions.real-world: Round-trip large public OpenAPI specifications and report what is lost.
scripts-descriptions.validate-output: Validate every document the test cases build with the Redocly linter (needs Node.js).

suggest.ext-yaml: To read YAML specifications through Serialization\YamlDecoder. Not required for writing YAML.
